Mia (ML Eng): quick heads-up — after promoting v3.2.0-beta to 10% traffic we started seeing a cohort-specific semantic flip on finance-policy prompts. example: same prompt used to return 'ineligible' -> now returns 'eligible' in several sessions. :eyes:
San (Research): ugh — is this showing up in BLEU/ROUGE? or something embedding-based? any sample ids?
Mia (ML Eng): BLEU/ROUGE basically flat. we track a semantic_parity metric (embedding cos distance + label consistency) — cohort shows a 4.2% drop vs baseline over last 20k queries. samples attached in the audit bucket.
San (Research): got it. sounds like a semantic drift, not surface-level text change. that explains why n-gram metrics miss it.
Ade (Platform): what are our auto-fallback rules right now? last I checked auto_fallback triggers at 5% drop for parity metric across 15 min window. that's global though — no safety cohort override.
Julian (SRE): ops-bot shows one deploy at 2026-03-20T17:02Z (v3.2.0-beta). we can immediate-pin sessions started before deploy to previous stable if needed.
Kim (PM): this is safety-sensitive for some customers — recommend conservative approach. can we lower threshold for safety-related cohorts and enable sticky session pinning?
Mia (ML Eng): proposing temporary config change. snippet below (what I'd apply to rollout policy):
```json
{
  "rollout": {
    "target": 0.10,
    "auto_fallback": {
      "metric": "semantic_parity",
      "threshold_pct_drop": 3.0,
      "window_minutes": 30,
      "cohort_overrides": {
        "safety_critical": 1.5
      }
    },
    "sticky_sessions": {
      "enabled": true,
      "pin_to": "previous",
      "min_tokens": 50
    }
  }
}
```
San (Research): I think 1.5% for safety_critical might still be too loose given downstream impact. can we set safety_critical to 1.0 and require manual approval for rollout above 5% for that cohort?
Ade (Platform): yes we can. platform accepts cohort override map. also can enable 'session_affinity: strict' for safety_critical so new sessions get routed to previous variant.
Julian (SRE): suggested immediate steps: 1) lower safety_critical override to 1.0, 2) enable strict session_affinity for that cohort, 3) run targeted shadow-eval over the flagged slice, 4) if parity drop > 2% in 15m, auto-rollback to previous stable.
OpsBot: Deploy event: v3.2.0-beta promoted to 10% at 1797778800 by ade. :white_check_mark:
Mia (ML Eng): action items agreed: - Ade to push temporary rollout patch (thresholds + sticky pin) - San to run focused semantic eval and post sample diffs in thread - Julian to prepare quick rollback playbook and healthcheck watch - Kim to notify impacted customer PMs.
Ade (Platform): I'll patch rollout policy in 5m and open a PR with the config. pinning on for safety_critical.
San (Research): running eval now — will post results in ~10m.
Julian (SRE): standing by for rollback trigger. set alert on parity_drop > 2% on safety_critical for 15m window.
Mia (ML Eng): thanks all — let's keep this chat as single source for the decision chain. :thumbsup:
